title: RACJ permit to produce or distribute alcohol in Quebec
plain_language_summary: Selling alcohol into Quebec requires a permit from the Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux (RACJ), Quebec's equivalent of AGCO.
raw_requirement_text: No person may manufacture, sell, or distribute alcoholic beverages in Quebec without a valid permit issued by the Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux.
authority: Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux (RACJ)

title: French-language labeling requirement (Bill 96 / Charter of the French Language)
plain_language_summary: Product labels sold in Quebec must have French as the predominant language on the packaging, this is a common trip-up for producers expanding from English-speaking provinces.
raw_requirement_text: Under the Charter of the French Language, French must appear on product labels and packaging sold in Quebec, and must be at least as prominent as any other language.
authority: Office québécois de la langue française (OQLF)

title: Federal meat inspection for interprovincial sale
plain_language_summary: Same federal requirement as other provinces: meat sold across a provincial border needs CFIA inspection, provincial-only inspection isn't sufficient.
raw_requirement_text: Meat products moved in interprovincial trade require inspection under the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations administered by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency.

title: Registre des titulaires de permis (trucking registration)
plain_language_summary: Commercial carriers operating in Quebec need to register with the Commission des transports du Québec, separate from CVOR-equivalent systems in other provinces.
raw_requirement_text: Owners and operators of heavy vehicles used for the transport of goods in Quebec must be registered under the Act respecting owners and operators of heavy vehicles.

title: Ordre professionnel registration
plain_language_summary: Regulated professions in Quebec require membership in the relevant professional order (ordre professionnel), and many require French-language competency assessment.
raw_requirement_text: Practising a regulated profession in Quebec requires membership in the corresponding ordre professionnel under the Professional Code, subject to mutual recognition arrangements.
